Latest Book:Maximo 1445 And the Supermachine | Uploaded: Sep 28, 2026
Categories:Superhero
Publication History:Issues: 3 |  Dates: 1941 - 1941
The superhero craze was going strong in 1941. Big Little Books used mostly established characters but decided to create their own superhero. To our benefit we have three issues of the original character Maximo. 1436 Maximo the Amazing Superman, 1444 Maximo and the Crystals of Doom and 1445 Maximo and the Supermachine.
